U.S. MARINE CORPS MOS 6531

6531 Aircraft Ordnance Technician

ASVAB score requirements, what the job involves, and how to raise the scores that count

Minimum ASVAB score

  • GT 105

Minimum AFQT

31

What a 6531 Does

Aircraft Ordnance Technicians load, arm and maintain the bombs, missiles, rockets and guns carried by Marine aircraft. You will inspect ammunition, test aircraft weapons systems and make repairs, following strict safety procedures on the flight line. It is fast-paced, precise work that requires a security clearance and normal color vision.

Scores That Count for 6531

  • GT (General Technical) = AR + MC + VE. Study: Arithmetic Reasoning, Mechanical Comprehension, Word Knowledge, Paragraph Comprehension

Marine Corps line scores average 100, and most people score between 60 and 140. Marine GT adds Mechanical Comprehension, so it is calculated differently from Army GT.

Other Requirements

  • Must meet explosives handler medical standards
  • U.S. citizenship required
  • Secret clearance eligibility
  • Normal color vision

Related Marine Corps Jobs

  • 6048 Flight Equipment Technician MM 105
  • 0231 Intelligence Specialist GT 110
  • 0311 Rifleman GT 90
  • 0331 Machine Gunner GT 90
  • 0341 Mortarman GT 90
